bbbPluginLogCollection.consent.title: Privacy notice - diagnostic logs
bbbPluginLogCollection.consent.intro: The ZIP file is created only on your device and contains:
bbbPluginLogCollection.consent.item1: Technical browser logs of this session
bbbPluginLogCollection.consent.item3: Browser and device information, your user and meeting ID
bbbPluginLogCollection.consent.note: Access data and names of other participants are removed or pseudonymized as far as possible. Nothing is transmitted automatically — you decide whether to share the file with support.
